<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:padding="24dp">

    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/title"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:text="My First Android App"
        android:textSize="24sp" />

    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/message"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:text="Ready when you are." />

    <Button
        android:id="@+id/helloButton"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:text="Say Hello" />
</LinearLayout>

<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <application android:label="My Android App">
        <activity android:name=".AppointmentActivity" />
        <activity android:name=".DashboardActivity" />
        <activity android:name=".LoginActivity" />
        <activity android:name=".MainActivity" android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>
        <activity android:name=".ProfileActivity" />
        <activity android:name=".RegistrationActivity" />
    </application>
</manifest>
files.app/src/main/res/layout/activity_login.x:
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:gravity="center"
    android:background="#111111"
    android:padding="20dp"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent">

    <TextView
        android:text="YANSSY TATTOO"
        android:textSize="32sp"
        android:textStyle="bold"
        android:textColor="#E53935"
        android:layout_marginBottom="20dp"/>

    <EditText
        android:id="@+id/username"
        android:hint="Username"
        android:background="#FFFFFF"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"/>

    <EditText
        android:id="@+id/password"
        android:hint="Password"
        android:inputType="textPassword"
        android:background="#FFFFFF"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"/>

    <Button
        android:id="@+id/btnLogin"
        android:text="ENTER INK"
        android:background="#E53935"
        android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="48dp"/>

    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/txtRegister"
        android:text="No account yet? REGISTER"
        android:textColor="#FFEB3B"
        android:layout_marginTop="15dp"/>
</LinearLayout>
files.app/src/main/res/layout/activity_registr:
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:background="#111111"
    android:padding="20dp"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent">

    <TextView
        android:text="Create Your Tattoo Profile"
        android:textSize="24sp"
        android:textStyle="bold"
        android:textColor="#E53935"
        android:layout_marginBottom="20dp"/>

    <EditText android:id="@+id/fullName" android:hint="Full Name" android:background="#FFFFFF" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="10dp"/>
    <EditText android:id="@+id/email" android:hint="Email Address" android:background="#FFFFFF" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="10dp"/>
    <EditText android:id="@+id/phone" android:hint="Phone Number" android:background="#FFFFFF" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="10dp"/>

    <Button
        android:id="@+id/btnRegister"
        android:text="REGISTER"
        android:background="#E53935"
        android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="48dp"/>
</LinearLayout>

<LinearLayout
    xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:background="#111111"
    android:padding="15dp"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent">

    <!-- HEADER -->
    <TextView
        android:text="Tattoo Menu"
        android:textSize="26sp"
        android:textStyle="bold"
        android:textColor="#E53935"
        android:layout_marginBottom="15dp"/>

    <!-- Tattoo Design Choices -->
    <TextView
        android:text="Choose Tattoo Design:"
        android:textSize="18sp"
        android:textStyle="bold"
        android:textColor="#FFEB3B"
        android:layout_marginBottom="10dp"/>
        
        
         <EditText android:id="@+id/fullName" android:hint="Type Of Tatto" android:background="#FFFFFF" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="10dp"/>

<Spinner
        android:id="@+id/spinnerTattooDesign"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:background="#FFFFFF"
        android:popupBackground="#222222"
        android:layout_marginBottom="20dp"/>

    <!-- Schedule Appointment -->
    <Button
        android:id="@+id/btnSchedule"
        android:text="Schedule Appointment"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="48dp"
        android:background="#FFEB3B"
        android:textColor="#000000"
        android:layout_marginTop="10dp"/>

    <!-- Payment -->
    <Button
        android:id="@+id/btnPayment"
        android:text="Proceed to Payment"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="48dp"
        android:background="#E53935"
        android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
        android:layout_marginTop="10dp"/>

    <!-- Upcoming Appointment -->
</LinearLayout>

<LinearLayout
    xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:background="#111111"
    android:padding="15dp"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent">

    <!-- HEADER -->
    <TextView
        android:text="Tattoo Menu"
        android:textSize="26sp"
        android:textStyle="bold"
        android:textColor="#E53935"
        android:layout_marginBottom="15dp"/>

    <!-- Tattoo Design List -->
    <ListView
        android:id="@+id/listTattooDesigns"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="200dp"
        android:divider="#444444"
        android:dividerHeight="1dp"
        android:background="#222222"
        android:layout_marginBottom="20dp"/>

    <!-- Buttons -->
    <Button
        android:id="@+id/btnSchedule"
        android:text="Schedule Appointment"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="48dp"
        android:background="#FFEB3B"
        android:textColor="#000000"
        android:layout_marginTop="10dp"/>

    <Button
        android:id="@+id/btnPayment"
        android:text="Proceed to Payment"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="48dp"
        android:background="#E53935"
        android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
        android:layout_marginTop="10dp"/>

    <!-- Upcoming Appointment -->
    <TextView
        android:id="@+id/txtUpcoming"
        android:text="Upcoming Appointment: Portrait Tattoo - Oct 5, 2026 @ 3PM"
        android:textSize="16sp"
        android:textColor="#FFEB3B"
        android:layout_marginTop="25dp"/>
</LinearLayout>
